title: next does not guide a fresh agent through the stages (#76)
symptom: right after init the next action says only 'Continue intent'; at test and at accept while verifying it names no case selection, no bug for a failed run and no human review
trigger: chough init, then chough next; advance to test; reach accept with the native change verifying
expected: after init: hi check, then chough context; at test: chough cases select, chough cases run and chough bug add; at accept while verifying: the human reviews through --close-gate with --verdict, or the review gate is opened, never an agent review
actual: Continue intent: Read scoped intent and native status, then choose the next action within the authorized scope.
impact: A fresh agent cannot get from intent to archive on its own (GitHub #76, items 1, 3 and 4)
source: GitHub issue #76; red on 0.5.0 at leif/0.6.0-76-0023-red dbd3d23b

notes.text: Added despite similar reports: The near matches are fixture and history bugs, not next's guidance
status: open -> verified. Fixed in plan step 12 (PR #238, f9c0ae67); the case passed after its 0.5.0 failure.
